name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLift_map_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLift_map_comp {a b c : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    catLift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map (f ≫ g)
      = catLift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map f ≫ catLift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map g

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLift_map_id
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLift_map_id {a : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} :
    catLift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map (𝟙 a) = 𝟙 (catLift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.obj a)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftUnit_comp_catLiftCounit
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftUnit_comp_catLiftCounit (A : Cat.{v₁, u₁}) :
    catLiftUnit A ⋙ catLiftCounit.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} A = 𝟭 A

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftCounit_comp_catLiftUnit
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftCounit_comp_catLiftUnit (A : Cat.{v₁, u₁}) :
    catLiftCounit.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} A ⋙ catLiftUnit A = 𝟭 _

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftUnit_map_down
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftUnit_map_down {C : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} {x y : C} (m : x ⟶ y) :
    ((catLiftUnit C).map m).down = m

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftCounit_naturality
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftCounit_naturality {C D : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (F : C ⟶ D) :
    (catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map F).toFunctor ⋙ catLiftCounit D
      = catLiftCounit C ⋙ F.toFunctor

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftCounit_obj_catLiftUnit_obj
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftCounit_obj_catLiftUnit_obj {C : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (x : C) :
    (catLiftCounit.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C).obj ((catLiftUnit C).obj x) = x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftCounit_map_catLiftUnit_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftCounit_map_catLiftUnit_map {C : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} {x y : C} (m : x ⟶ y) :
    (catLiftCounit.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C).map ((catLiftUnit C).map m) = m

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftCounit_obj_catPseudoULift_map_obj
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftCounit_obj_catPseudoULift_map_obj {C D : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (F : C ⟶ D) (x : C) :
    (catLiftCounit.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} D).obj
        ((catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map F).toFunctor.obj ((catLiftUnit C).obj x))
      = F.toFunctor.obj x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftCounit_map_catPseudoULift_map₂
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftCounit_map_catPseudoULift_map₂ {C D : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} {F G : C ⟶ D}
    (η : F ⟶ G) (x : C) :
    (catLiftCounit.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} D).map
        ((catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map₂ η).toNatTrans.app ((catLiftUnit C).obj x))

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catLiftCounit_map_catPseudoULift_map₂'
statement:
@[simp] lemma catLiftCounit_map_catPseudoULift_map₂' {C D : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} {F G : C ⟶ D}
    (η : F ⟶ G) (x : ↑(catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.obj C)) :
    (catLiftCounit.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} D).map
        ((catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map₂ η).toNatTrans.app x)
      = η.toNatTrans.app ((catLiftCounit C).obj x)

CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catPseudoULift_map_catLiftUnit_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma catPseudoULift_map_catLiftUnit_map {C D : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (F : C ⟶ D)
    {x y : C} (m : x ⟶ y) :
    (catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.map F).toFunctor.map ((catLiftUnit C).map m)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catPseudoULift_map₂_app_catLiftUnit
statement:
@[simp] lemma catPseudoULift_map₂_app_catLiftUnit {C D : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} {F G : C ⟶ D}

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.catPseudoULift_mapComp_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma catPseudoULift_mapComp_hom_app {C D E : Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (F : C ⟶ D) (G : D ⟶ E)
    (x : ↑(catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.obj C)) :
    (catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}.mapComp F G).hom.toNatTrans.app x = 𝟙 _

statement:
lemma backwards_map_comp (x : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) {A₀ B₀ : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj x)}
    (m : A₀ ⟶ B₀) (c : Bᵒᵖ) (W : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop x.1)).obj c)) :
    (((((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor x).map m).as.app c).toNatTrans).app W)
      = (x.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op W)).toFunctor.map m

name: Biyoneda.backwards_naturality_naturality_core
statement:
lemma backwards_naturality_naturality_core {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} {f g : a ⟶ b}
    (η : f ⟶ g) (x : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) {γ : Bᵒᵖ}
    (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj γ)) :
    (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
        ((b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map ((η.2.as.app a.1).toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          (b.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
      (b.2.mapComp g.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
        (g.2.naturality (g.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x =
    ((b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
        (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
      (f.2.app γ).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map₂ (op2 (ZZ ◁ η.1.unop2))).toNatTrans.app x) ≫
        (η.2.as.app γ).toNatTrans.app
          ((a.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op
            ((postcomp (unop γ) g.1.unop).toCatHom.toFunctor.obj ZZ))).toFunctor.obj x)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hmc := Cat.Hom₂.congr_app
    (b.2.toOplax.mapComp_naturality_left η.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)) ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x)
  have hnn := g.2.naturality_naturality_app (η.1 ▷ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) x
  have hmod := modification_naturality_app η.2 (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) x
  simp only [Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, Cat.whiskerRight_toNatTrans] at hmc hnn hmod
  
  have hmc_inv : (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
        ((b.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
      (b.2.mapComp g.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) =
      (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
        (b.2.map₂ (η.1 ▷ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toNatTrans.app ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) := by
    apply (Iso.comp_inv_eq ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (b.2.mapComp g.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ))).app
      ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x))).mpr
    erw [Category.assoc]
    apply (Iso.eq_inv_comp ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ))).app
      ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x))).mpr
    exact hmc.symm
  
  have hnn_inv : (b.2.map₂ (η.1 ▷ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toNatTrans.app
        ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
      (g.2.naturality (g.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x =
      (g.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x ≫
        (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map₂ (η.1 ▷ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toNatTrans.app x) := by
    apply (Iso.comp_inv_eq ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (g.2.naturality (g.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ))).app x)).mpr
    erw [Category.assoc]
    apply (Iso.eq_inv_comp ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso
      (g.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ))).app x)).mpr
    exact hnn.symm
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  erw [Category.assoc]
  erw [reassoc_of% hmc_inv]
  erw [Category.assoc]
  erw [hnn_inv]
  
  have hη2 := (η.2.as.app γ).toNatTrans.naturality
    ((a.2.map₂ (op2 (ZZ ◁ η.1.unop2))).toNatTrans.app x)
  have hMCinv := (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.naturality
    ((η.2.as.app a.1).toNatTrans.app x)
  dsimp at hmod hη2 hMCinv
  
  have hmod_inv : (b.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
        ((η.2.as.app a.1).toNatTrans.app x) ≫
      (g.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x =
      (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x ≫
        (η.2.as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.obj x) := by
    apply (Iso.comp_inv_eq ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (g.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ))).app x)).mpr
    erw [Category.assoc]
    apply (Iso.eq_inv_comp ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso
      (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ))).app x)).mpr
    exact hmod.symm
  
  
  
  
  
  
  rw [reassoc_of% hMCinv, reassoc_of% hmod_inv]
  exact congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) hη2.symm)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_nn_lhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_nn_lhs_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g)
    (x : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) {γ : Bᵒᵖ} (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj γ)) :
    ((((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor b).map ((yonedaEvaluation'.map₂ η).toNatTrans.app x) ≫
        (backwardsNaturalityIso g x).hom).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)
      = (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app x) ≫
              (η.2.as.app b.1).toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
          ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
              ((g.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
            (b.2.mapComp g.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
            (g.2.naturality (g.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_nn_rhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_nn_rhs_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g)
    (x : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) {γ : Bᵒᵖ} (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj γ)) :
    ((((backwardsNaturalityIso f x).hom ≫
        (yonedaPairing.map₂ η).toNatTrans.app
          ((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a).obj x)).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)
      = ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
              ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
            (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
            (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          ((f.2.app γ).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map₂ (op2 (ZZ ◁ η.1.unop2))).toNatTrans.app x) ≫
            (η.2.as.app γ).toNatTrans.app
              ((a.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op
                ((postcomp (unop γ) g.1.unop).toCatHom.toFunctor.obj ZZ))).toFunctor.obj x))

name: Biyoneda.backwards_nn_slide
statement:
lemma backwards_nn_slide {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g)
    (x : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) :
    ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app x) ≫
        (η.2.as.app b.1).toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
      (g.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x
      = (f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x ≫
        ((b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map ((η.2.as.app a.1).toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          (b.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := modification_naturality_app η.2 g.1 x
  have h2 := f.2.naturality_naturality_app η.1 x
  have h3 := (b.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.naturality ((η.2.as.app a.1).toNatTrans.app x)
  dsimp at h1 h2 h3
  rw [Category.assoc, h1, reassoc_of% h2, ← h3]

name: Biyoneda.backwards_id_core
statement:
lemma backwards_id_core (F : Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}) {b₀ γ : Bᵒᵖ} (ZZ : unop γ ⟶ unop b₀)
    (eval : ↑(F.obj b₀)) :
    ((F.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫
        (F.mapComp (𝟙 b₀) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app eval ≫ (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _)) ≫
      (F.map₂ (op2 (ρ_ ZZ).hom)).toNatTrans.app eval
      = (F.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
          ((F.mapId b₀).hom.toNatTrans.app eval)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_id_lhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_id_lhs_app (a : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) (x : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a))
    (γ : Bᵒᵖ) (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).obj γ)) :
    ((((backwardsNaturalityIso (𝟙 a) x).hom ≫
        (yonedaPairing.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans.app
          ((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a).obj x)).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)
      = ((a.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫
            (a.2.mapComp (𝟙 a.1) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x ≫ (𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _)) ≫
          ((((yonedaPairing.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans.app
            ((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a).obj x)).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_id_rhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_id_rhs_app (a : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) (x : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a))
    (γ : Bᵒᵖ) (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).obj γ)) :
    ((((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a).map
        ((yonedaEvaluation'.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans.app x)).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_comp_map_app
statement:
lemma backwards_comp_map_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (g : a ⟶ b)
    {Z₁ Z₂ : ↑(yonedaPairing.obj a)} (μ : Z₁ ⟶ Z₂) (γ : Bᵒᵖ)
    (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj γ)) :
    ((((yonedaPairing.map g).toFunctor.map μ).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)
      = (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((μ.as.app γ).toNatTrans.app (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop))

name: Biyoneda.backwards_comp_lhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_comp_lhs_app {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (x : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) (γ : Bᵒᵖ) (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop c.1)).obj γ)) :
    ((((backwardsNaturalityIso (f ≫ g) x).hom ≫
        (yonedaPairing.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app
          ((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a).obj x)).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)
      = ((c.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
              (((f ≫ g).2.naturality (f ≫ g).1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
            (c.2.mapComp (f ≫ g).1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              (((f ≫ g).2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
            ((f ≫ g).2.naturality ((f ≫ g).1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          ((((yonedaPairing.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app
            ((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a).obj x)).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_comp_rhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_comp_rhs_app {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (x : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) (γ : Bᵒᵖ) (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop c.1)).obj γ)) :
    ((((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor c).map
          ((yonedaEvaluation'.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
        (backwardsNaturalityIso g ((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor.obj x)).hom ≫
        (yonedaPairing.map g).toFunctor.map
          (backwardsNaturalityIso f x).hom).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ)
      = (c.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
            ((yonedaEvaluation'.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          ((c.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
              ((g.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
                ((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
            (c.2.mapComp g.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((g.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
            (g.2.naturality (g.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
          (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
            ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop))).toFunctor.map
                ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
              (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop))).inv.toNatTrans.app
                ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
              (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop))).inv.toNatTrans.app x)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_comp_core
statement:
lemma backwards_comp_core {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (x : ↑(a.2.obj a.1)) {γ : Bᵒᵖ} (ZZ : unop γ ⟶ unop c.1) :
    ((c.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
          (((f.2 ≫ g.2).naturality (f.1 ≫ g.1)).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
        (c.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ g.1) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
          (((f.2 ≫ g.2).app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
          ((f.2 ≫ g.2).naturality ((f.1 ≫ g.1) ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
      (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
        ((f.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((a.2.map₂ (op2 (α_ ZZ g.1.unop f.1.unop).inv)).toNatTrans.app x)) =
    (c.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
        ((evalMapComp f.1 f.2 g.1 g.2).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
      ((c.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
            ((g.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
              ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) ≫
          (c.2.mapComp g.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((g.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj
                ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) ≫
            (g.2.naturality (g.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) ≫
        (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop))).toFunctor.map
              ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
            (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop))).inv.toNatTrans.app
                ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
              (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop))).inv.toNatTrans.app x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [strongTrans_comp_naturality_app f.2 g.2 (f.1 ≫ g.1) x,
    strongTrans_comp_naturality_inv_app f.2 g.2 ((f.1 ≫ g.1) ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) x]
  dsimp only [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.comp_app, Cat.Hom.comp_toFunctor, Functor.comp_obj]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hslide : (c.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ g.1) ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((g.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
      (g.2.naturality ((f.1 ≫ g.1) ≫ ZZ.op)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
      (g.2.app (Opposite.op (unop γ))).toFunctor.map
        ((f.2.naturality ((f.1 ≫ g.1) ≫ ZZ.op)).inv.toNatTrans.app x)
      = (c.2.map ZZ.op).toFunctor.map
          ((g.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ g.1)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
        (g.2.naturality ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((b.2.map (f.1 ≫ g.1)).toFunctor.obj ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
        (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((b.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ g.1) ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
        (g.2.app (Opposite.op (unop γ))).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.naturality ((f.1 ≫ g.1) ≫ ZZ.op)).inv.toNatTrans.app x) :=
    (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
      (Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app_assoc g.2 (f.1 ≫ g.1) ZZ.op
        ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) _)).trans
      (Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc _ _ _)
  rw [hslide]
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (c.2.map ZZ.op).toFunctor
    ((g.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ g.1)).hom.toNatTrans.app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x))
    ((g.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ g.1)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x))
    (Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (g.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ g.1)) _)]
  have hnat0 : (c.2.map ZZ.op).toFunctor.map
        ((g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map ((f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ g.1)).hom.toNatTrans.app x)) ≫
      (g.2.naturality ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((b.2.map (f.1 ≫ g.1)).toFunctor.obj ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x))
      = (g.2.naturality ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map (f.1 ≫ g.1)).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
        (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((b.2.map ZZ.op).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ g.1)).hom.toNatTrans.app x)) :=
    (g.2.naturality ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.naturality _
  rw [← Category.assoc, hnat0, Category.assoc]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp]
  have hslideR : (c.2.mapComp g.1 ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((g.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj
          ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) ≫
      (g.2.naturality (g.1 ≫ ZZ.op)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
      (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
        ((b.2.map (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop).op).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          (b.2.mapComp f.1 (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop).op).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
          (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop).op)).inv.toNatTrans.app x)
      = (c.2.map ZZ.op).toFunctor.map
          ((g.2.naturality g.1).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) ≫
        (g.2.naturality ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((b.2.map g.1).toFunctor.obj
            ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) ≫
        (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((b.2.mapComp g.1 ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) ≫
        (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
        ((b.2.map (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop).op).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          (b.2.mapComp f.1 (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop).op).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
          (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ (ZZ ≫ g.1.unop).op)).inv.toNatTrans.app x) :=
    (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
      (Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app_assoc g.2 g.1 ZZ.op
        ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x)) _)).trans
      (Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc _ _ _)
  rw [hslideR]
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (c.2.map ZZ.op).toFunctor
    ((g.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
      ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x)))
    ((g.2.naturality g.1).inv.toNatTrans.app
      ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x)))
    (Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (g.2.naturality g.1) _)]
  have hev : (evalMapComp f.1 f.2 g.1 g.2).hom.toNatTrans.app x
      = (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.mapComp f.1 g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
            (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x)) := by
    rw [evalMapComp_hom_app]
    simp [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [hev]
  have hnatR : (c.2.map ZZ.op).toFunctor.map
        ((g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.mapComp f.1 g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
            (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) ≫
      (g.2.naturality ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app ((b.2.map g.1).toFunctor.obj
        ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x)))
      = (g.2.naturality ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map (f.1 ≫ g.1)).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
        (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((b.2.map ZZ.op).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.mapComp f.1 g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
              (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj x))) :=
    (g.2.naturality ZZ.op).inv.toNatTrans.naturality _
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun t => t ≫ _) hnatR)).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)).symm
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp]
  refine Eq.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _) (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) ?_)
  refine Eq.trans ((g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map_comp _ _).symm ?_
  refine congrArg (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map ?_
  exact naturality_comp_assoc_core f.2 f.1 g.1 ZZ.op x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.ModificationIntoCats.naturality
statement:
lemma ModificationIntoCats.naturality {B : Type u} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B]
    {F : B ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w₂, v₂}} {G : B ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w₃, v₃}} {η θ : StrongTransIntoCats F G}
    (d : ModificationIntoCats η θ) {a b : B} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft (F.map f).toFunctor (d.app b) ≫ (θ.naturality f).hom =
      (η.naturality f).hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (d.app a) (G.map f).toFunctor
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simpa using d.naturality' f x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.StrongTransIntoCats.naturality_naturality
statement:
lemma StrongTransIntoCats.naturality_naturality {a b : A} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (F.map₂ η).toNatTrans (data.app b) ≫ (data.naturality g).hom =
      (data.naturality f).hom ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (data.app a) (G.map₂ η).toNatTrans
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simpa using data.naturality_naturality' η x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.StrongTransIntoCats.naturality_id
statement:
lemma StrongTransIntoCats.naturality_id (a : A) :
    (data.naturality (𝟙 a)).hom ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft (data.app a) (G.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans =
      Functor.whiskerRight (F.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans (data.app a) ≫
        (Functor.leftUnitor (data.app a)).hom ≫ (Functor.rightUnitor (data.app a)).inv
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  dsimp [Functor.whiskerLeft]
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using data.naturality_id' a x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.StrongTransIntoCats.naturality_comp
statement:
lemma StrongTransIntoCats.naturality_comp {a b c : A} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (data.naturality (f ≫ g)).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (data.app a) (G.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans =
      Functor.whiskerRight (F.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans (data.app c) ≫
        (Functor.associator (F.map f).toFunctor (F.map g).toFunctor (data.app c)).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (F.map f).toFunctor (data.naturality g).hom ≫
        (Functor.associator (F.map f).toFunctor (data.app b) (G.map g).toFunctor).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (data.naturality f).hom (G.map g).toFunctor ≫
        (Functor.associator (data.app a) (G.map f).toFunctor (G.map g).toFunctor).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simpa [Functor.associator, Functor.whiskerRight] using data.naturality_comp' f g x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.lift_modification_lhs
statement:
lemma lift_modification_lhs {A : Type u} [Bicategory A]
    {F : Pseudofunctor A Cat.{max v₁ v₂, max u₁ u₂}} {G : Pseudofunctor A Cat.{v₁, u₁}}
    {η θ : StrongTransIntoCats F G} (d : ModificationIntoCats η θ) {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (x : F.obj a) :
    (catLiftCounit (G.obj b)).map
        ((F.map f ◁ NatTrans.toCatHom₂ (Functor.whiskerRight (d.app b) (catLiftUnit (G.obj b))) ≫
          (θ.lift.naturality f).hom).toNatTrans.app x)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.lift_modification_rhs
statement:
lemma lift_modification_rhs {A : Type u} [Bicategory A]
    {F : Pseudofunctor A Cat.{max v₁ v₂, max u₁ u₂}} {G : Pseudofunctor A Cat.{v₁, u₁}}
    {η θ : StrongTransIntoCats F G} (d : ModificationIntoCats η θ) {a b : A} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (x : F.obj a) :
    (catLiftCounit (G.obj b)).map
        (((η.lift.naturality f).hom ≫
          NatTrans.toCatHom₂ (Functor.whiskerRight (d.app a) (catLiftUnit (G.obj a))) ▷
            (G.comp catPseudoULift.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂}).map f).toNatTrans.app x)
      = ((η.naturality f).hom.app x ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ (G.map f).toFunctor.map ((d.app a).app x)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.StrongTransIntoCats.lift_comp_liftDom_naturality_app
statement:
lemma StrongTransIntoCats.lift_comp_liftDom_naturality_app {A : Type u} [Bicategory A]

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_naturality_id_lhs_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_naturality_id_lhs_app {A : Type u} [Bicategory A]
    {F G : Pseudofunctor A Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (η : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans F G) (a : A)
    (x : F.obj a) :
    ((η.naturality (𝟙 a)).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (G.mapId a).hom).toNatTrans.app x

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_naturality_id_rhs_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_naturality_id_rhs_app {A : Type u} [Bicategory A]
    {F G : Pseudofunctor A Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (η : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans F G) (a : A)
    (x : F.obj a) :
    ((F.mapId a).hom ▷ η.app a ≫ (λ_ (η.app a)).hom ≫ (ρ_ (η.app a)).inv).toNatTrans.app x
      = (η.app a).toFunctor.map ((F.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_naturality_comp_lhs_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_naturality_comp_lhs_app {A : Type u} [Bicategory A]
    {F G : Pseudofunctor A Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (η : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans F G) {a b c : A}
    (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (x : F.obj a) :
    ((η.naturality (f ≫ g)).hom ≫ η.app a ◁ (G.mapComp f g).hom).toNatTrans.app x
      = (Cat.Hom.toNatIso (η.naturality (f ≫ g))).hom.app x ≫
        (G.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app ((η.app a).toFunctor.obj x)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_naturality_comp_rhs_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_naturality_comp_rhs_app {A : Type u} [Bicategory A]
    {F G : Pseudofunctor A Cat.{v₁, u₁}} (η : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans F G) {a b c : A}
    (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (x : F.obj a) :
    ((F.mapComp f g).hom ▷ η.app c ≫
      (α_ (F.map f) (F.map g) (η.app c)).hom ≫
        F.map f ◁ (η.naturality g).hom ≫
          (α_ (F.map f) (η.app b) (G.map g)).inv ≫
            (η.naturality f).hom ▷ G.map g ≫
              (α_ (η.app a) (G.map f) (G.map g)).hom).toNatTrans.app x
      = (η.app c).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫
          (η.naturality g).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map f).toFunctor.obj x) ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫
            (G.map g).toFunctor.map ((η.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫ 𝟙 _

name: Biyoneda.forwards_naturality_core
statement:
lemma forwards_naturality_core {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    {X Y : yoneda₀ (unop a.1) ⟶ a.2} (h : X ⟶ Y) :
    (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((h.as.app b.1).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop b.1) ≫ f.1.unop)) ≫
      (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((Y.app b.1).toFunctor.map (λ_ f.1.unop).hom) ≫
        (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((Y.app b.1).toFunctor.map (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
          (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((Y.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))) =
    ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((X.app b.1).toFunctor.map (λ_ f.1.unop).hom) ≫
        (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((X.app b.1).toFunctor.map (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
          (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((X.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)))) ≫
      (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map
        ((h.as.app a.1).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (h.as.app b.1).toNatTrans.naturality ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv)
  have h2 := modification_naturality_app h f.1 (𝟙 (unop a.1))
  have h3 := (f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.naturality
    ((h.as.app a.1).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)))
  dsimp at h1 h2 h3
  
  
  
  
  
  rw [(X.app b.1).toFunctor.map_comp (λ_ f.1.unop).hom (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv,
    (Y.app b.1).toFunctor.map_comp (λ_ f.1.unop).hom (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv] at h1
  have h1' := congrArg (fun m ↦ (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map m) h1
  have h2' := congrArg (fun m ↦ (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map m) h2
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at h1' h2'
  rw [← reassoc_of% h1']
  
  
  erw [h2']
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: Biyoneda.unitor_conj_pad
statement:
lemma unitor_conj_pad {x y : B} {f g : x ⟶ y} (θ : f ⟶ g) :
    (λ_ f).hom ≫ θ ≫ (ρ_ g).inv
      = ((λ_ f).hom ≫ (ρ_ f).inv) ≫ (ρ_ f).hom ≫ θ ≫ (ρ_ g).inv

name: Biyoneda.forwards_naturality_naturality_unitor
statement:
lemma forwards_naturality_naturality_unitor {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} {f g : a ⟶ b}
    (η : f ⟶ g) (Z : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans (yoneda₀ (unop a.1)) a.2) :
    (Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ η.1.unop2 ≫ (λ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
      (Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
        (Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)) =
    ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
        (Z.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))) ≫
      (a.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1)))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  have hnn := Z.naturality_naturality_app η.1 (𝟙 (unop a.1))
  
  
  have hL : ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ η.1.unop2 ≫ (λ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
        ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv)
      = ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
        ((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)) := by
    simp
    exact unitor_conj_pad _
  refine Eq.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
    (fun t => t ≫ (Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)))
    (((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map hL))) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
    (fun t => t ≫ (Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)))
    ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map_comp _ _)) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
    (fun t => (Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫ t) hnn) ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: Biyoneda.forwards_naturality_naturality_lhs_app

lemma forwards_naturality_naturality_lhs_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} {f g : a ⟶ b}
    (η : f ⟶ g) (Z : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans (yoneda₀ (unop a.1)) a.2) :

            ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map (𝟙 (unop b.1) ◁ η.1.unop2)) ≫

name: Biyoneda.forwards_naturality_naturality_core
statement:
lemma forwards_naturality_naturality_core {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} {f g : a ⟶ b}
    (η : f ⟶ g) (Z : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans (yoneda₀ (unop a.1)) a.2) :
    (((yonedaPairing.map₂ η).toNatTrans.app Z).as.app b.1).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop b.1)) ≫
        (g.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
          ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
            ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (Z.naturality g.1)).app (𝟙 (unop a.1))).hom) =
    (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
          ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
            ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (Z.naturality f.1)).app (𝟙 (unop a.1))).hom) ≫
    (yonedaEvaluation'.map₂ η).toNatTrans.app ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1)))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  have hnat := (η.2.as.app b.1).toNatTrans.naturality
    ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
      ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (Z.naturality g.1)).app (𝟙 (unop a.1))).hom)
  have hu : (Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ η.1.unop2 ≫ (λ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
        ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
          ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (Z.naturality g.1)).app (𝟙 (unop a.1))).hom)
      = ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
          ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (Z.naturality f.1)).app (𝟙 (unop a.1))).hom) ≫
        (a.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1))) :=
    forwards_naturality_naturality_unitor η Z
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
    (fun t => t ≫ (g.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
      ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
        ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (Z.naturality g.1)).app (𝟙 (unop a.1))).hom))
    (forwards_naturality_naturality_lhs_app η Z)) ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg
    (fun t => (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
      ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
        ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (Z.naturality f.1)).app (𝟙 (unop a.1))).hom) ≫ t)
    (forwards_naturality_naturality_rhs_app η ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1))))).symm
  
  
  simp only [Bicategory.id_whiskerLeft]
  
  refine Eq.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun t => (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
      ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ η.1.unop2 ≫ (λ_ g.1.unop).inv)) ≫ t)
    hnat.symm) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun t => t ≫ (η.2.as.app b.1).toNatTrans.app
      ((a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.obj ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1)))))
    (((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map hu))) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun t => t ≫ (η.2.as.app b.1).toNatTrans.app
      ((a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.obj ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1)))))
    ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map_comp _ _)) ?_
  exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: Biyoneda.forwards_naturality_id_core
statement:
lemma forwards_naturality_id_core (a : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}))
    (Z : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans (yoneda₀ (unop a.1)) a.2) :
    ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ (𝟙 a.1).unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ (𝟙 a.1).unop).inv) ≫
        (Z.naturality (𝟙 a.1)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))) ≫
      (yonedaEvaluation'.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans.app ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1))) =
    (((yonedaPairing.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans.app Z).as.app a.1).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  dsimp only [yonedaPairing, yonedaPairingComposite, Pseudofunctor.comp, homPseudo,
    homMapId, homMapIdApp,
    Pseudofunctor.prod, Pseudofunctor.op, yonedaEvaluation', evaluationPseudo]
  simp only [prelax_map₂_app, Iso.trans_hom, Cat.Hom.isoMk_hom, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app,
    Cat.toCatHom₂_toNatTrans, Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, NatTrans.comp_app,
    PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, Category.assoc]
  have hZ := Cat.Hom₂.congr_app (Z.naturality_id a.1) (𝟙 (unop a.1))
  simp only [Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, NatTrans.comp_app, Cat.whiskerLeft_toNatTrans,
    Cat.whiskerRight_toNatTrans, whiskerLeft_app, whiskerRight_app] at hZ
  rw [hZ]
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  simp
  change _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ (Z.app a.1).toFunctor.map (ρ_ (𝟙 (unop a.1))).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _
  simp

name: Biyoneda.yonedaEvaluation_mapComp_app
statement:
lemma yonedaEvaluation_mapComp_app {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (g : b ⟶ c) (X : ↑(a.2.obj a.1)) :
    (yonedaEvaluation'.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app X
      = (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.mapComp f.1 g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
            (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (yonedaEvaluation'.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app X
      = (evalMapComp f.1 f.2 g.1 g.2).hom.toNatTrans.app X from rfl, evalMapComp_hom_app]
  simp [Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

lemma yonedaPairing_mapObj_naturality_app {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})}
    (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (Z : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans (yoneda₀ (unop a.1)) a.2) :
    (((yonedaPairing.map f).toFunctor.obj Z).naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
        (𝟙 (unop b.1))
      = (f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((Z.app c.1).toFunctor.map
              (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop b.1)))) ≫
          (f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
              (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app b.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop b.1)))) ≫
            (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
              ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.obj
                (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app b.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop b.1))))
proof:
:= by
  exact (strongTrans_comp_naturality_app (postcomp₂ f.1.unop) (Z ≫ f.2) g.1
      (𝟙 (unop b.1))).trans
    (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
      (strongTrans_comp_naturality_app Z f.2 g.1
        (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app b.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop b.1)))))

name: Biyoneda.forwards_naturality_comp_core
statement:
lemma forwards_naturality_comp_core {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (Z : Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans (yoneda₀ (unop a.1)) a.2) :
    ((f.2 ≫ g.2).app c.1).toFunctor.map
          ((Z.app c.1).toFunctor.map
              ((λ_ (f.1 ≫ g.1).unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ (f.1 ≫ g.1).unop).inv) ≫
            (Z.naturality (f.1 ≫ g.1)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))) ≫
      (yonedaEvaluation'.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app
        ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1))) =
    (((yonedaPairing.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app Z).as.app c.1).toNatTrans.app
        (𝟙 (unop c.1)) ≫
      (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((((yonedaPairing.map f).toFunctor.obj Z).app c.1).toFunctor.map
                ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv) ≫
              (((yonedaPairing.map f).toFunctor.obj Z).naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
                (𝟙 (unop b.1))) ≫
        (yonedaEvaluation'.map g).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
              ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
                (Z.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))))
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  rw [yonedaPairing_mapComp_app f g Z c.1 (𝟙 (unop c.1))]
  simp only [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.comp_app, Cat.Hom.comp_toFunctor, Functor.comp_map,
    Functor.comp_obj]
  rw [yonedaEvaluation_mapComp_app f g ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1))),
    yonedaPairing_mapObj_naturality_app f g Z]
  change _ =
    (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
        ((f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
          ((Z.app c.1).toFunctor.map (α_ (𝟙 (unop c.1)) g.1.unop f.1.unop).inv)) ≫
      (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
              ((Z.app c.1).toFunctor.map
                (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app c.1).toFunctor.map
                  ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv))) ≫
            (f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
                ((Z.app c.1).toFunctor.map
                  (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop b.1)))) ≫
              (f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
                  ((Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
                    (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app b.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop b.1)))) ≫
                (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
                  ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.obj
                    (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app b.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop b.1))))) ≫
        (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
          ((b.2.map g.1).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
              ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
                (Z.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)))))
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  refine Eq.trans ((g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map_comp _ _).symm ?_
  refine congrArg (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map ?_
  have hslide : (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
        ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.obj
          (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app b.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop b.1)))) ≫
      (b.2.map g.1).toFunctor.map
        ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
          ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
            (Z.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))))
      = (f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
          ((a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.map
            ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
              (Z.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)))) ≫
        (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
          ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1)))) :=
    ((f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.naturality _).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
    (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) hslide)))).symm
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  refine Eq.trans ?_
    ((congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
        (Functor.map_comp_assoc (f.2.app c.1).toFunctor _ _ _).symm).trans
      (Functor.map_comp_assoc (f.2.app c.1).toFunctor _ _ _).symm).symm
  refine congrArg (fun t => t ≫ (f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
    ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj ((Z.app a.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1))))) ?_
  refine congrArg (f.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map ?_
  refine Eq.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
    (Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_app Z f.1 g.1 (𝟙 (unop a.1)))) ?_
  simp
  have hsl : (Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
        (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app b.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop b.1))) ≫
      (a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.map
        ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv))
      = (Z.app c.1).toFunctor.map
          (((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).map g.1).toFunctor.map
            ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv)) ≫
        (Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
          (((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).map f.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1))) :=
    ((Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.naturality _).symm
  have htail : (Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
        (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app b.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop b.1))) ≫
      (a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.map
        ((Z.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) ≫
          (Z.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1)))
      = (Z.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            (((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).map g.1).toFunctor.map
              ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv)) ≫
          (Z.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
            (((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).map f.1).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 (unop a.1))) ≫
          (a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.map
            ((Z.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop a.1))) := by
    exact (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
        ((a.2.map g.1).toFunctor.map_comp _ _)).trans
      (((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun t => t ≫ _) hsl)).trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _))
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
    (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) htail))).symm
  refine Eq.trans (Functor.map_comp_assoc (Z.app c.1).toFunctor _ _ _).symm ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_
    ((congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
        (Functor.map_comp_assoc (Z.app c.1).toFunctor _ _ _).symm)).trans
      ((congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
          (Functor.map_comp_assoc (Z.app c.1).toFunctor _ _ _).symm).trans
        (Functor.map_comp_assoc (Z.app c.1).toFunctor _ _ _).symm)).symm
  refine congrArg (fun t => t ≫ _) ?_
  refine congrArg (Z.app c.1).toFunctor.map ?_
  have hp : ((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app c.1).toFunctor.map
        ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv)
      = ((λ_ g.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ g.1.unop).inv) ▷ f.1.unop := rfl
  have ha : ((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop b.1))
      = (α_ g.1.unop (𝟙 (unop b.1)) f.1.unop).hom := rfl
  have hy : ((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).map g.1).toFunctor.map
        ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv)
      = g.1.unop ◁ ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv) := rfl
  rw [hp, ha, hy]
  bicategory

lemma map_map_comp_dist {C D E : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    (F : D ⥤ E) (G : C ⥤ D) {X Y Z : C} (u : X ⟶ Y) (v : Y ⟶ Z) {W : D} (N : G.obj Z ⟶ W) :

name: Biyoneda.strongTrans_comp_naturality_hom_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_comp_naturality_hom_app {F G H : Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}} (η : F ⟶ G) (θ : G ⟶ H)
    {X Y : Bᵒᵖ} (k : X ⟶ Y) (x : ↑(F.obj X)) :
    ((η ≫ θ).naturality k).hom.toNatTrans.app x =
      (θ.app Y).toFunctor.map ((η.naturality k).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
        (θ.naturality k).hom.toNatTrans.app ((η.app X).toFunctor.obj x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.categoryStruct_comp_naturality_hom]
  iterate (first | erw [eqToHom_refl] | erw [Category.id_comp] | erw [Category.comp_id])

name: Biyoneda.unit_functor_core
statement:
lemma unit_functor_core {b₀ : B} {G : Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}} (α : yoneda₀ b₀ ⟶ G) (b : Bᵒᵖ)
    {X Y : unop b ⟶ b₀} (θ : X ⟶ Y) :
    (G.map₂ (op2 θ)).toNatTrans.app ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
      ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op Y)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
        (α.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ Y).hom)
      = ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op X)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
          (α.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ X).hom) ≫ (α.app b).toFunctor.map θ
proof:
:= by
  have hconj : (α.app b).toFunctor.map (θ ▷ 𝟙 b₀)
      = (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op X)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
        (G.map₂ (op2 θ)).toNatTrans.app ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
        (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op Y)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) :=
    Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_naturality_conj_app α (op2 θ) (𝟙 b₀)
  have hcancel := Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op X)) (𝟙 b₀)
  have hkey : (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op X)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
        (α.app b).toFunctor.map (θ ▷ 𝟙 b₀)
      = (G.map₂ (op2 θ)).toNatTrans.app ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
        (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op Y)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) :=
    (congrArg (fun t => (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op X)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫ t)
        hconj).trans
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun t => t ≫ _) hcancel).trans (Category.id_comp _)))
  have hunit : (α.app b).toFunctor.map (θ ▷ 𝟙 b₀) ≫ (α.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ Y).hom
      = (α.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ X).hom ≫ (α.app b).toFunctor.map θ :=
    ((α.app b).toFunctor.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (α.app b).toFunctor.map (rightUnitor_naturality θ)).trans
        ((α.app b).toFunctor.map_comp _ _))
  refine Eq.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun t => t ≫ (α.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ Y).hom) hkey.symm) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun t =>
    (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op X)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫ t) hunit) ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: Biyoneda.unit_obj_core
statement:
lemma unit_obj_core {b₀ : B} {G : Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}} (α : yoneda₀ b₀ ⟶ G) {c d : Bᵒᵖ}
    (f : c ⟶ d) (W : unop c ⟶ b₀) :
    ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W ≫ f)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
        (α.app d).toFunctor.map (ρ_ (f.unop ≫ W)).hom) ≫
      (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W
      = (G.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op W) f).hom.toNatTrans.app
          ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
        (G.map f).toFunctor.map
          ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
            (α.app c).toFunctor.map (ρ_ W).hom)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := (Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_app α (Quiver.Hom.op W) f (𝟙 b₀)).symm
  have hPH := Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W ≫ f)) (𝟙 b₀)
  have hHN := Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W)) (𝟙 b₀)
  have hNH := Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app (α.naturality f) W
  have hslide : (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app
        (((yoneda₀ b₀).map (Quiver.Hom.op W)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
      (G.map f).toFunctor.map ((α.app c).toFunctor.map (ρ_ W).hom) ≫
        (α.naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app W
      = (α.app d).toFunctor.map (f.unop ◁ (ρ_ W).hom) :=
    strongTrans_naturality_slide α f (ρ_ W).hom
  have hA : (G.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op W) f).hom.toNatTrans.app
        ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀))
      = (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W ≫ f)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
        ((α.app d).toFunctor.map
            (((yoneda₀ b₀).mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op W) f).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
          (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app
              (((yoneda₀ b₀).map (Quiver.Hom.op W)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
            (G.map f).toFunctor.map
              ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀))) := by
    rw [hcomp, ← Category.assoc, hPH, Category.id_comp]
  have hK : (G.map f).toFunctor.map
        ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
      (G.map f).toFunctor.map
        ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
          (α.app c).toFunctor.map (ρ_ W).hom)
      = (G.map f).toFunctor.map ((α.app c).toFunctor.map (ρ_ W).hom) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, hHN, Category.id_comp]
  have hS : (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app
        (((yoneda₀ b₀).map (Quiver.Hom.op W)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
      (G.map f).toFunctor.map ((α.app c).toFunctor.map (ρ_ W).hom)
      = (α.app d).toFunctor.map (f.unop ◁ (ρ_ W).hom) ≫
        (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W := by
    rw [← hslide, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hNH]
    exact (congrArg (fun t => (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app
      (((yoneda₀ b₀).map (Quiver.Hom.op W)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫ t)
      (Category.comp_id ((G.map f).toFunctor.map ((α.app c).toFunctor.map (ρ_ W).hom)))).symm
  rw [hA, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hK, hS]
  refine congrArg
    (fun t => (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op W ≫ f)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫ t) ?_
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  refine congrArg
    (fun t => (α.app d).toFunctor.map t ≫ (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W) ?_
  exact (by bicategory :
    (ρ_ (f.unop ≫ W)).hom = (α_ f.unop W (𝟙 b₀)).hom ≫ f.unop ◁ (ρ_ W).hom)

name: Biyoneda.unit_natiso_core
statement:
lemma unit_natiso_core {b₀ : B} {G : Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}} {X Y : yoneda₀ b₀ ⟶ G} (m : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : Bᵒᵖ) (V : unop b ⟶ b₀) :
    (G.map (Quiver.Hom.op V)).toFunctor.map ((m.as.app (op b₀)).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
      ((Y.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
        (Y.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ V).hom)
      = ((X.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
          (X.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ V).hom) ≫ (m.as.app b).toNatTrans.app V
proof:
:= by
  have hmod := Cat.Hom₂.congr_app (m.as.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)) (𝟙 b₀)
  simp only [Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, NatTrans.comp_app, Cat.whiskerLeft_toNatTrans,
    Cat.whiskerRight_toNatTrans, whiskerLeft_app, whiskerRight_app] at hmod
  have hnat : (X.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ V).hom ≫ (m.as.app b).toNatTrans.app V
      = (m.as.app b).toNatTrans.app (((yoneda₀ b₀).map (Quiver.Hom.op V)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
        (Y.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ V).hom :=
    (m.as.app b).toNatTrans.naturality (ρ_ V).hom
  have hXi := Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app (X.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)) (𝟙 b₀)
  have hYh := Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (Y.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)) (𝟙 b₀)
  have hM : (G.map (Quiver.Hom.op V)).toFunctor.map ((m.as.app (op b₀)).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀))
      = (X.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
        (m.as.app b).toNatTrans.app (((yoneda₀ b₀).map (Quiver.Hom.op V)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
        (Y.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) := by
    rw [hmod, ← Category.assoc, hXi, Category.id_comp]
  have hcancel : (Y.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
      (Y.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op V)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
        (Y.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ V).hom
      = (Y.app b).toFunctor.map (ρ_ V).hom := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hYh, Category.id_comp]
  rw [hM]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hcancel, ← hnat]

name: Biyoneda.unit_top_lhs
statement:
lemma unit_top_lhs :
    ((postcomp₂ g ≫ α ≫ β).naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₁) ≫
        ((postcomp₂ g ≫ α ≫ β).app γ).toFunctor.map (ρ_ ZZ).hom
      = (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₁ ≫ g)) ≫
          (β.app γ).toFunctor.map
            ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₁ ≫ g) ≫
              (α.app γ).toFunctor.map ((α_ ZZ (𝟙 b₁) g).inv ≫ ((ρ_ ZZ).hom ▷ g)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [strongTrans_comp_naturality_inv_app (postcomp₂ g) (α ≫ β) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) (𝟙 b₁),
    strongTrans_comp_naturality_inv_app α β (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)
      (((postcomp₂ g).app (op b₁)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₁))]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: Biyoneda.unit_top_rhs
statement:
lemma unit_top_rhs :
    ((G.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
          ((β.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map
            ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv) ≫
              (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀))) ≫
        ((G.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
            ((β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)).hom.toNatTrans.app
              ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀))) ≫
          (G.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op g) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((β.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀))) ≫
          (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)))) ≫
      (β.app γ).toFunctor.map
        ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g))).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
          (α.app γ).toFunctor.map (ρ_ (ZZ ≫ g)).hom)
      = (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₁ ≫ g)) ≫
          (β.app γ).toFunctor.map
            ((F.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
                ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv) ≫
                  (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
              (F.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op g) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
                ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
              ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g))).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
                (α.app γ).toFunctor.map (ρ_ (ZZ ≫ g)).hom))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app_assoc β (Quiver.Hom.op g) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)
    ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)), Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc]
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (G.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor _ _
    (Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g))
      ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)))]
  have hslide : (G.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
        ((β.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map
          ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv) ≫
            (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀))) ≫
      (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((F.map (Quiver.Hom.op g)).toFunctor.obj ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)))
      = (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₁ ≫ g)) ≫
          (β.app γ).toFunctor.map
            ((F.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
              ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv) ≫
                (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀))) :=
    (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.naturality _
  rw [reassoc_of% hslide]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]

name: Biyoneda.unit_top_alpha
statement:
lemma unit_top_alpha :
    (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₁ ≫ g) ≫
        (α.app γ).toFunctor.map ((α_ ZZ (𝟙 b₁) g).inv ≫ ((ρ_ ZZ).hom ▷ g))
      = (F.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
            ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv) ≫
              (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
          (F.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op g) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)) ≫
          ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
            (α.app γ).toFunctor.map (ρ_ (ZZ ≫ g)).hom)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app_assoc α (Quiver.Hom.op g) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)
    (𝟙 b₀), Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc]
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (F.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor _ _
    (Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)) (𝟙 b₀))]
  rw [map_map_comp_assoc (α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor (F.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor]
  have hsl : (F.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
        ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv)) ≫
      (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        (((yoneda₀ b₀).map (Quiver.Hom.op g)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀))
      = (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₁ ≫ g) ≫
        (α.app γ).toFunctor.map (ZZ ◁ ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv)) :=
    (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.naturality _
  rw [reassoc_of% hsl]
  refine congrArg (fun t =>
    (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₁ ≫ g) ≫ t) ?_
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  refine congrArg (α.app γ).toFunctor.map ?_
  exact (by bicategory : (α_ ZZ (𝟙 b₁) g).inv ≫ ((ρ_ ZZ).hom ▷ g)
    = ZZ ◁ ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv) ≫ (α_ ZZ g (𝟙 b₀)).inv ≫ (ρ_ (ZZ ≫ g)).hom)
