statement:
lemma unit_top_core :
    ((postcomp₂ g ≫ α ≫ β).naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₁) ≫
        ((postcomp₂ g ≫ α ≫ β).app γ).toFunctor.map (ρ_ ZZ).hom
      = ((G.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
            ((β.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map
              ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.map ((λ_ g).hom ≫ (ρ_ g).inv) ≫
                (α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)).hom.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀))) ≫
          ((G.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
              ((β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g)).hom.toNatTrans.app
                ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀))) ≫
            (G.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op g) (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((β.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀))) ≫
            (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op g ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((α.app (op b₀)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₀)))) ≫
        (β.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((α.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op (ZZ ≫ g))).inv.toNatTrans.app (𝟙 b₀) ≫
            (α.app γ).toFunctor.map (ρ_ (ZZ ≫ g)).hom)
proof:
:=
  (unit_top_lhs α β g ZZ).trans
    ((congrArg (fun t => (β.naturality (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((α.app (op b₁)).toFunctor.obj (𝟙 b₁ ≫ g)) ≫ (β.app γ).toFunctor.map t)
      (unit_top_alpha α g ZZ)).trans (unit_top_rhs α β g ZZ).symm)

name: Biyoneda.counit_core
statement:
lemma counit_core :
    (G.mapId y).hom.toNatTrans.app ((β.app y).toFunctor.obj ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj s))
      = (((G.map (𝟙 y)).toFunctor.map ((β.naturality u).hom.toNatTrans.app s) ≫
            (G.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((β.app x).toFunctor.obj s) ≫
            (β.naturality (u ≫ 𝟙 y)).inv.toNatTrans.app s) ≫
          (β.app y).toFunctor.map
            ((F.map₂ ((ρ_ u).hom ≫ (λ_ u).inv)).toNatTrans.app s ≫
              (F.mapComp (𝟙 x) u).hom.toNatTrans.app s)) ≫
        (β.app y).toFunctor.map ((F.map u).toFunctor.map ((F.mapId x).hom.toNatTrans.app s))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (G.map (𝟙 y)).toFunctor.map ((β.naturality u).hom.toNatTrans.app s) ≫
        (G.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((β.app x).toFunctor.obj s) ≫
        (β.naturality (u ≫ 𝟙 y)).inv.toNatTrans.app s
      = (β.naturality (𝟙 y)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj s) ≫
        (β.app y).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).inv.toNatTrans.app s) := by
    rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app β u (𝟙 y) s,
      Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc,
      map_comp_cancel_assoc (G.map (𝟙 y)).toFunctor _ _
        (Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (β.naturality u) s)]
  have h2 : (G.mapId y).hom.toNatTrans.app ((β.app y).toFunctor.obj ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj s))
      = (β.naturality (𝟙 y)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj s) ≫
        (β.app y).toFunctor.map
          ((F.mapId y).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj s)) := by
    rw [← Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_id_app β y ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj s),
      ← Category.assoc,
      Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app, Category.id_comp]
  rw [h1, h2]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  refine congrArg (fun t => (β.naturality (𝟙 y)).inv.toNatTrans.app
    ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj s) ≫ t) ?_
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  refine congrArg (β.app y).toFunctor.map ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [Pseudofunctor.whiskerRight_mapId_hom_app, Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc]
  have hm := Cat.Hom₂.congr_app
    (show (F.map₂ ((ρ_ u).hom ≫ (λ_ u).inv)) ≫ (F.map₂ (λ_ u).hom) = F.map₂ (ρ_ u).hom by
      rw [← PrelaxFunctor.map₂_comp]; congr 1; simp) s
  simp only [Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, NatTrans.comp_app] at hm
  rw [hm]
  have hr : (F.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).hom.toNatTrans.app s ≫
      (F.mapId y).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj s)
      = (F.map₂ (ρ_ u).hom).toNatTrans.app s := by
    simp
  rw [← hr, ← Category.assoc, Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app]
  exact (Category.id_comp _).symm

name: Biyoneda.counit_square_lhs_app
statement:
lemma counit_square_lhs_app :
    (yonedaEvaluation.map f ◁ (Cat.Hom.isoMk (yonedaInvHomIdNatIso b)).hom).toNatTrans.app
        (⟨s⟩ : ↑(yonedaEvaluation.obj a))
      = ⟨(b.2.mapId b.1).hom.toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj s))⟩

name: Biyoneda.counit_id_naturality_app
statement:
lemma counit_id_naturality_app :
    ((show (@yonedaEvaluation B _) ⟶ yonedaEvaluation from
      𝟙 yonedaEvaluation).naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app (⟨s⟩ : ↑(yonedaEvaluation.obj a))
      = 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _

name: Biyoneda.counit_square_rhs_app
statement:
lemma counit_square_rhs_app :
    ((Cat.Hom.isoMk (yonedaInvHomIdNatIso a)).hom ▷ yonedaEvaluation.map f).toNatTrans.app
        (⟨s⟩ : ↑(yonedaEvaluation.obj a))
      = ⟨(f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
          ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.mapId a.1).hom.toNatTrans.app s))⟩

name: Biyoneda.counit_backwards_app
statement:
lemma counit_backwards_app :
    (yonedaLemmaForwards.app b).toFunctor.map
        ((yonedaLemmaBackwards.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app
          (⟨s⟩ : ↑(yonedaEvaluation.obj a)))
      = ⟨((backwardsNaturalityIso f s).hom.as.app b.1).toNatTrans.app (𝟙 (unop b.1))⟩

name: Biyoneda.counit_forwards_app
statement:
lemma counit_forwards_app :
    (yonedaLemmaForwards.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app
        ((yonedaLemmaBackwards.app a).toFunctor.obj (⟨s⟩ : ↑(yonedaEvaluation.obj a)))
      = ⟨(f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map
          ((a.2.map₂ (op2 ((λ_ f.1.unop).hom ≫ (ρ_ f.1.unop).inv))).toNatTrans.app s ≫
            (a.2.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op (𝟙 (unop a.1))) f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app s) ≫ 𝟙 _⟩

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.prelax_map₂_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma prelax_map₂_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × B} {f g : a ⟶ b} (η : f ⟶ g)
    (x : unop a.1 ⟶ a.2) :
    ((prelax B).map₂ η).toNatTrans.app x
      = η.1.unop2 ▷ (x ≫ f.2) ≫ g.1.unop ◁ (x ◁ η.2)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.unopFunctor_obj_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma unopFunctor_obj_comp {a b c : Bᵒᵖ} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) :
    (unopFunctor a c).obj (f ≫ g) = g.unop ≫ f.unop

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.unopFunctor_obj_id
statement:
@[simp] lemma unopFunctor_obj_id {a : Bᵒᵖ} :
    (unopFunctor a a).obj (𝟙 a) = 𝟙 (unop a)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.unop2_leftUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] lemma unop2_leftUnitor_hom {a b : Bᵒᵖ} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (λ_ f).hom.unop2 = (ρ_ f.unop).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.unop2_rightUnitor_hom
statement:
@[simp] lemma unop2_rightUnitor_hom {a b : Bᵒᵖ} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (ρ_ f).hom.unop2 = (λ_ f.unop).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.unop2_whiskerLeft
statement:
@[simp] lemma unop2_whiskerLeft {a b c : Bᵒᵖ} {f : a ⟶ b} {g g' : b ⟶ c} (η : g ⟶ g') :
    (f ◁ η).unop2 = η.unop2 ▷ f.unop

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.unop2_whiskerRight
statement:
@[simp] lemma unop2_whiskerRight {a b c : Bᵒᵖ} {f f' : a ⟶ b} {g : b ⟶ c} (η : f ⟶ f') :
    (η ▷ g).unop2 = g.unop ◁ η.unop2

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.unop2_associator_hom
statement:
@[simp] lemma unop2_associator_hom {a b c d : Bᵒᵖ} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (α_ f g h).hom.unop2 = (α_ h.unop g.unop f.unop).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.unop2_associator_inv
statement:
@[simp] lemma unop2_associator_inv {a b c d : Bᵒᵖ} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : c ⟶ d) :
    (α_ f g h).inv.unop2 = (α_ h.unop g.unop f.unop).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.prod_associator_hom_fst_unop2
statement:
@[simp] lemma prod_associator_hom_fst_unop2 {a b c d : Bᵒᵖ × B} (fg : a ⟶ b) (hi : b ⟶ c)
    (jk : c ⟶ d) :
    (α_ fg hi jk).hom.1.unop2 = (α_ jk.1.unop hi.1.unop fg.1.unop).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.prod_leftUnitor_hom_fst_unop2
statement:
@[simp] lemma prod_leftUnitor_hom_fst_unop2 {a b : Bᵒᵖ × B} (fg : a ⟶ b) :
    (λ_ fg).hom.1.unop2 = (ρ_ fg.1.unop).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.prod_rightUnitor_hom_fst_unop2
statement:
@[simp] lemma prod_rightUnitor_hom_fst_unop2 {a b : Bᵒᵖ × B} (fg : a ⟶ b) :
    (ρ_ fg).hom.1.unop2 = (λ_ fg.1.unop).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.prelax_map_obj
statement:
@[simp] lemma prelax_map_obj {a b : Bᵒᵖ × B} (f : a ⟶ b) (x : unop a.1 ⟶ a.2) :
    ((prelax B).map f).toFunctor.obj x = f.1.unop ≫ (x ≫ f.2)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.prelax_map_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma prelax_map_map {a b : Bᵒᵖ × B} (f : a ⟶ b) {x y : unop a.1 ⟶ a.2} (η : x ⟶ y) :
    ((prelax B).map f).toFunctor.map η = f.1.unop ◁ (η ▷ f.2)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.homMapIdApp_naturality
statement:
lemma homMapIdApp_naturality {p : Bᵒᵖ × B} {h h' : unop p.1 ⟶ p.2} (η : h ⟶ h') :
    𝟙 (unop p.1) ◁ (η ▷ 𝟙 p.2) ≫ (homMapIdApp B (p := p) h').hom
      = (homMapIdApp B (p := p) h).hom ≫ η

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.homMapCompApp_naturality
statement:
lemma homMapCompApp_naturality {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × B} (fg : a ⟶ b) (hi : b ⟶ c)
    {x y : unop a.1 ⟶ a.2} (F : x ⟶ y) :
    (hi.1.unop ≫ fg.1.unop) ◁ (F ▷ (fg.2 ≫ hi.2)) ≫ (homMapCompApp B fg hi y).hom
      = (homMapCompApp B fg hi x).hom ≫ hi.1.unop ◁ ((fg.1.unop ◁ (F ▷ fg.2)) ▷ hi.2)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [homMapCompApp]
  simp only [Iso.symm_hom, Bicategory.whiskerLeftIso_hom, Bicategory.whiskerRightIso_hom]
  bicategory

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.homMapId_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma homMapId_hom_app (p : Bᵒᵖ × B) (h : unop p.1 ⟶ p.2) :
    (homMapId B p).hom.toNatTrans.app h = (homMapIdApp B (p := p) h).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.homMapComp_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma homMapComp_hom_app {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × B} (fg : a ⟶ b) (hi : b ⟶ c)
    (x : unop a.1 ⟶ a.2) :
    (homMapComp B fg hi).hom.toNatTrans.app x = (homMapCompApp B fg hi x).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.homMapId_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma homMapId_inv_app (p : Bᵒᵖ × B) (h : unop p.1 ⟶ p.2) :
    (homMapId B p).inv.toNatTrans.app h = (homMapIdApp B (p := p) h).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.homMapComp_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma homMapComp_inv_app {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × B} (fg : a ⟶ b) (hi : b ⟶ c)
    (x : unop a.1 ⟶ a.2) :
    (homMapComp B fg hi).inv.toNatTrans.app x = (homMapCompApp B fg hi x).inv

name: Biyoneda.backwards_inner_core
statement:
lemma backwards_inner_core {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) {α : Bᵒᵖ}
    {XX YY : unop α ⟶ unop b.1} (h : XX ⟶ YY) (X : ↑(a.2.obj a.1)) :
    (b.2.map₂ (op2 h)).toNatTrans.app
        ((b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X)) ≫
      (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op YY)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
        (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op YY)).inv.toNatTrans.app X =
    (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op XX)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
      (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op XX)).inv.toNatTrans.app X ≫
        (f.2.app α).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map₂ (f.1 ◁ op2 h)).toNatTrans.app X)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Cat.Hom₂.congr_app
    (b.2.toOplax.mapComp_naturality_right f.1 (op2 h)) ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X)
  have h2 := f.2.naturality_naturality_app (f.1 ◁ op2 h) X
  dsimp at h1 h2
  
  have s1 : (b.2.map₂ (op2 h)).toNatTrans.app
        ((b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X)) ≫
      (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op YY)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) =
      (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op XX)).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
      (b.2.map₂ (f.1 ◁ op2 h)).toNatTrans.app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) := by
    apply (Iso.comp_inv_eq ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso
      (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op YY))).app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))).mpr
    erw [Category.assoc]
    apply (Iso.eq_inv_comp ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso
      (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op XX))).app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))).mpr
    exact h1.symm
  
  have s2 : (b.2.map₂ (f.1 ◁ op2 h)).toNatTrans.app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
      (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op YY)).inv.toNatTrans.app X =
      (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op XX)).inv.toNatTrans.app X ≫
      (f.2.app α).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map₂ (f.1 ◁ op2 h)).toNatTrans.app X) := by
    apply (Iso.comp_inv_eq ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso
      (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op YY))).app X)).mpr
    erw [Category.assoc]
    apply (Iso.eq_inv_comp ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso
      (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op XX))).app X)).mpr
    exact h2.symm
  rw [← Category.assoc, s1]
  erw [Category.assoc, s2]

name: Biyoneda.backwards_app_core
statement:
lemma backwards_app_core {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (X : ↑(a.2.obj a.1))
    {α : Bᵒᵖ} {XX YY : unop α ⟶ unop b.1} (h : XX ⟶ YY) :
    (b.2.map₂ (op2 h)).toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj X)) ≫
        ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op YY)).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
          (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op YY)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
          (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op YY)).inv.toNatTrans.app X)
      = ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op XX)).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
          (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op XX)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
          (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op XX)).inv.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
        (f.2.app α).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map₂ (f.1 ◁ op2 h)).toNatTrans.app X)
proof:
:= by
  have hslide :
      (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op XX)).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
          (b.2.map₂ (op2 h)).toNatTrans.app
            ((b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))
        = (b.2.map₂ (op2 h)).toNatTrans.app
              ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj X)) ≫
            (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op YY)).toFunctor.map
              ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) :=
    (b.2.map₂ (op2 h)).toNatTrans.naturality _
  rw [← reassoc_of% hslide]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) (backwards_inner_core f h X)

name: Biyoneda.backwardsNaturalityIsoApp_hom_app
statement:
lemma backwardsNaturalityIsoApp_hom_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (X : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) (α : Bᵒᵖ) (W : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj α)) :
    (backwardsNaturalityIsoApp f X α).hom.toNatTrans.app W
      = (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op W)).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
          (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op W)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
          (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op W)).inv.toNatTrans.app X

name: Biyoneda.backwards_square_lhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_square_lhs_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (X : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) {a₁ b₁ : Bᵒᵖ} (f₁ : a₁ ⟶ b₁)
    (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj a₁)) :
    ((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).map f₁ ◁ (backwardsNaturalityIsoApp f X b₁).hom ≫
      (((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a ⋙ (yonedaPairing.map f).toFunctor).obj X).naturality
        f₁).hom).toNatTrans.app ZZ
      = ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).toFunctor.map
              ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
            (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
            (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).inv.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
        ((postcomp₂ f.1.unop ≫ (backwardsTrans a X ≫ f.2)).naturality f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app ZZ

name: Biyoneda.backwards_square_rhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_square_rhs_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (X : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) {a₁ b₁ : Bᵒᵖ} (f₁ : a₁ ⟶ b₁)
    (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj a₁)) :
    (((((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor ⋙ yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor b).obj X).naturality
        f₁).hom ≫ (backwardsNaturalityIsoApp f X a₁).hom ▷ b.2.map f₁).toNatTrans.app ZZ
      = (b.2.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
          ((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
        (b.2.map f₁).toFunctor.map
          ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
              ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
            (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
              ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
            (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app X)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_square_tail_app
statement:
lemma backwards_square_tail_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (X : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) {a₁ b₁ : Bᵒᵖ} (f₁ : a₁ ⟶ b₁)
    (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj a₁)) :
    ((backwardsTrans a X ≫ f.2).app b₁).toFunctor.map
          (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).naturality f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app ZZ) ≫
        (f.2.app b₁).toFunctor.map
            (((backwardsTrans a X).naturality f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
              (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app a₁).toFunctor.obj ZZ)) ≫
          (f.2.naturality f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
            (((backwardsTrans a X).app a₁).toFunctor.obj
              (((postcomp₂ f.1.unop).app a₁).toFunctor.obj ZZ))
      = (f.2.app b₁).toFunctor.map
            ((a.2.map₂ (op2 (α_ f₁.unop ZZ f.1.unop).hom)).toNatTrans.app X) ≫
          (f.2.app b₁).toFunctor.map
              ((a.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
            (f.2.naturality f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
              ((a.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.obj X)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_square_core
statement:
lemma backwards_square_core {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (X : ↑(a.2.obj a.1))
    {a₁ b₁ : Bᵒᵖ} (f₁ : a₁ ⟶ b₁) (ZZ : unop a₁ ⟶ unop b.1) :
    ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
        (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
        (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).inv.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
      (f.2.app b₁).toFunctor.map
          ((a.2.map₂ (op2 (α_ f₁.unop ZZ f.1.unop).hom)).toNatTrans.app X) ≫
        (f.2.app b₁).toFunctor.map
            ((a.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
          (f.2.naturality f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
            ((a.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.obj X)
    = (b.2.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
        ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj X)) ≫
      (b.2.map f₁).toFunctor.map
        ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
          (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
          (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app X)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  
  have hslide :
      (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
          (b.2.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
            ((b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))
        = (b.2.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
              ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.obj ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj X)) ≫
            (b.2.map f₁).toFunctor.map
              ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
                ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X)) :=
    (b.2.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.naturality _
  rw [← reassoc_of% hslide]
  refine congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) ?_
  
  have hconj := Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_naturality_conj_app f.2
      (v := f.1 ≫ (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)) (v' := (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) ≫ f₁)
      (op2 (α_ f₁.unop ZZ f.1.unop).hom) X
  rw [hconj]
  have hcancel : (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).inv.toNatTrans.app X ≫
      (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).hom.toNatTrans.app X = 𝟙 _ := by simp
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% hcancel]
  
  have hz : (b.2.mapComp (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
        ((b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))
      = (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁)).inv.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
          (b.2.map₂ (op2 (α_ f₁.unop ZZ f.1.unop).hom)).toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
          (b.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app
            ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
          (b.2.map f₁).toFunctor.map
            ((b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).hom.toNatTrans.app
              ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X)) :=
    (Iso.eq_inv_comp ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ ≫ f₁))).app
      ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))).mpr
        (Pseudofunctor.mapComp_assoc_right_hom_app b.2 f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁
          ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))
  rw [hz]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (b.2.map f₁).toFunctor
    ((b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).hom.toNatTrans.app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))
    ((b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))
    (by simp)]
  
  refine congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) ?_)
  
  refine (Iso.inv_comp_eq ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso
    (b.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁)).app ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X))).mp ?_
  change (b.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).inv.toNatTrans.app
      ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫ _ = _
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app_assoc,
    Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc]
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (f.2.app b₁).toFunctor
    ((a.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).inv.toNatTrans.app X)
    ((a.2.mapComp (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ) f₁).hom.toNatTrans.app X) (by simp)]
  simp

name: Biyoneda.backwards_naturality_square
statement:
lemma backwards_naturality_square {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (X : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)) {a₁ b₁ : Bᵒᵖ} (f₁ : a₁ ⟶ b₁) :
    (yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).map f₁ ◁ (backwardsNaturalityIsoApp f X b₁).hom ≫
      (((yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a ⋙ (yonedaPairing.map f).toFunctor).obj X).naturality
        f₁).hom =
    ((((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor ⋙ yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor b).obj X).naturality
        f₁).hom ≫ (backwardsNaturalityIsoApp f X a₁).hom ▷ b.2.map f₁
proof:
:= by
  apply Cat.Hom₂.ext_app
  intro ZZ
  refine Eq.trans (backwards_square_lhs_app f X f₁ ZZ)
    (Eq.trans ?_ (backwards_square_rhs_app f X f₁ ZZ).symm)
  rw [strongTrans_comp_naturality_app, strongTrans_comp_naturality_app]
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) (backwards_square_tail_app f X f₁ ZZ)) ?_
  exact backwards_square_core f X f₁ ZZ

name: Biyoneda.backwards_natural_lhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_natural_lhs_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    {X Y : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)} (m : X ⟶ Y) {γ : Bᵒᵖ}
    (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj γ)) :
    (((((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor ⋙ yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor b).map m ≫
        (backwardsNaturalityIso f Y).hom).as.app γ).toNatTrans).app ZZ
      = (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map m)) ≫
          (backwardsNaturalityIsoApp f Y γ).hom.toNatTrans.app ZZ

name: Biyoneda.backwards_natural_rhs_app
statement:
lemma backwards_natural_rhs_app {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    {X Y : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)} (m : X ⟶ Y) {γ : Bᵒᵖ}
    (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop b.1)).obj γ)) :
    ((((backwardsNaturalityIso f X).hom ≫
        (yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a ⋙ (yonedaPairing.map f).toFunctor).map
          m).as.app γ).toNatTrans).app ZZ
      = (backwardsNaturalityIsoApp f X γ).hom.toNatTrans.app ZZ ≫
          (f.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
            ((a.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map m)

name: Biyoneda.backwards_natural_core
statement:
lemma backwards_natural_core {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    {X Y : ↑(a.2.obj a.1)} (m : X ⟶ Y) {γ : Bᵒᵖ} (ZZ : unop γ ⟶ unop b.1) :
    (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
        ((f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map m)) ≫
      ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app Y) ≫
        (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj Y) ≫
        (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app Y)
    = ((b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
        (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
        (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app X) ≫
      (f.2.app γ).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map m)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : (f.2.app b.1).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map m) ≫
        (f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app Y
      = (f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.app X ≫
        (b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.map m) :=
    (f.2.naturality f.1).hom.toNatTrans.naturality m
  have h2 : (b.2.map (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
          ((b.2.map f.1).toFunctor.map ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.map m)) ≫
        (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj Y)
      = (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.obj X) ≫
        (b.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.map m) :=
    (b.2.mapComp f.1 (Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.naturality _
  have h3 : (b.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.app a.1).toFunctor.map m) ≫
        (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app Y
      = (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.app X ≫
        (f.2.app γ).toFunctor.map ((a.2.map (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).toFunctor.map m) :=
    (f.2.naturality (f.1 ≫ Quiver.Hom.op ZZ)).inv.toNatTrans.naturality m
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hnat, Functor.map_comp_assoc, reassoc_of% h2, h3]

name: Biyoneda.backwards_naturality_iso_natural
statement:
lemma backwards_naturality_iso_natural {a b : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b)
    {X Y : ↑(yonedaEvaluation'.obj a)} (f₁ : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((yonedaEvaluation'.map f).toFunctor ⋙ yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor b).map f₁ ≫
      (backwardsNaturalityIso f Y).hom =
    (backwardsNaturalityIso f X).hom ≫
      (yonedaLemmaBackwardsFunctor a ⋙ (yonedaPairing.map f).toFunctor).map f₁
proof:
:= by
  apply homCategory.ext
  intro γ
  apply Cat.Hom₂.ext_app
  intro ZZ
  exact Eq.trans (backwards_natural_lhs_app f f₁ ZZ)
    (Eq.trans (backwards_natural_core f f₁ ZZ) (backwards_natural_rhs_app f f₁ ZZ).symm)

    {F G : C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v}} {η θ : F ⟶ G} (Γ : η ⟶ θ) {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b)

lemma Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_naturality_conj {B : Type u₁} [Bicategory.{w₁, v₁} B]
    {C : Type u₂} [Bicategory.{w₂, v₂} C] {F G : B ⥤ᵖ C} (α : F ⟶ G) {y z : B}
    {v v' : y ⟶ z} (σ : v ⟶ v') :
    F.map₂ σ ▷ α.app z = (α.naturality v).hom ≫ α.app y ◁ G.map₂ σ ≫ (α.naturality v').inv
proof:
:= by

statement:
lemma evalMapComp_hom (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    (evalMapComp u α v β).hom
      = (F.mapComp u v).hom ▷ (α.app z ≫ β.app z) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map v) (α.app z ≫ β.app z)).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (F.map v) (α.app z) (β.app z)).inv ≫
          (α.naturality v).hom ▷ β.app z ≫
          (α_ (α.app y) (G.map v) (β.app z)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map v ≫ β.app z)).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_inv
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_inv (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    (evalMapComp u α v β).inv
      = (α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map v ≫ β.app z)).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (α.app y) (G.map v) (β.app z)).inv ≫
          (α.naturality v).inv ▷ β.app z ≫
          (α_ (F.map v) (α.app z) (β.app z)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map v) (α.app z ≫ β.app z)).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp u v).inv ▷ (α.app z ≫ β.app z)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_id_left_hom
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_id_left_hom (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    (evalMapComp (𝟙 x) (𝟙 F) u α).hom
      = (F.mapComp (𝟙 x) u).hom ▷ (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y) ≫
        (α_ (F.map (𝟙 x)) (F.map u) (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y)).hom ≫
        F.map (𝟙 x) ◁ ((α_ (F.map u) (𝟙 (F.obj y)) (α.app y)).inv ≫
          ((ρ_ (F.map u)).hom ≫ (λ_ (F.map u)).inv) ▷ α.app y ≫
          (α_ (𝟙 (F.obj x)) (F.map u) (α.app y)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map (𝟙 x)) (𝟙 (F.obj x)) (F.map u ≫ α.app y)).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_id_right_hom
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_id_right_hom (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    (evalMapComp u α (𝟙 y) (𝟙 G)).hom
      = (F.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).hom ▷ (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y)) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map (𝟙 y)) (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y))).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (F.map (𝟙 y)) (α.app y) (𝟙 (G.obj y))).inv ≫
          (α.naturality (𝟙 y)).hom ▷ 𝟙 (G.obj y) ≫
          (α_ (α.app y) (G.map (𝟙 y)) (𝟙 (G.obj y))).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map (𝟙 y) ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y))).inv

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMap₂_leftUnitor
statement:
lemma evalMap₂_leftUnitor (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    evalMap₂ (λ_ u).hom (λ_ α).hom
      = F.map₂ (λ_ u).hom ▷ (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y) ≫
        F.map u ◁ (λ_ (α.app y)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMap₂_rightUnitor
statement:
lemma evalMap₂_rightUnitor (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    evalMap₂ (ρ_ u).hom (ρ_ α).hom
      = F.map₂ (ρ_ u).hom ▷ (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y)) ≫
        F.map u ◁ (ρ_ (α.app y)).hom

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_left_unitor_rhs_app
statement:
lemma eval_left_unitor_rhs_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    (((F.mapComp (𝟙 x) u).hom ▷ (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y) ≫
        (α_ (F.map (𝟙 x)) (F.map u) (𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y)).hom ≫
        F.map (𝟙 x) ◁ ((α_ (F.map u) (𝟙 (F.obj y)) (α.app y)).inv ≫
          ((ρ_ (F.map u)).hom ≫ (λ_ (F.map u)).inv) ▷ α.app y ≫
          (α_ (𝟙 (F.obj x)) (F.map u) (α.app y)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map (𝟙 x)) (𝟙 (F.obj x)) (F.map u ≫ α.app y)).inv) ≫
      (F.mapId x).hom ▷ evalMap u α ≫ (λ_ (evalMap u α)).hom).toNatTrans.app Z
    = ((𝟙 (F.obj y) ≫ α.app y).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp (𝟙 x) u).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫ (α.app y).toFunctor.map ((𝟙 _) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _)) ≫
      (evalMap u α).toFunctor.map ((F.mapId x).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫ (𝟙 _)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_left_unitor
statement:
lemma eval_left_unitor (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    evalMap₂ (λ_ u).hom (λ_ α).hom
      = (evalMapComp (𝟙 x) (𝟙 F) u α).hom ≫
        (F.mapId x).hom ▷ evalMap u α ≫ (λ_ (evalMap u α)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalMap₂_leftUnitor, evalMapComp_id_left_hom, F.map₂_left_unitor]
  apply Cat.Hom₂.ext_app; intro Z
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (eval_left_unitor_rhs_app u α Z).symm
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_right_unitor_rhs_app
statement:
lemma eval_right_unitor_rhs_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    (((F.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).hom ▷ (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y)) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map (𝟙 y)) (α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y))).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (F.map (𝟙 y)) (α.app y) (𝟙 (G.obj y))).inv ≫
          (α.naturality (𝟙 y)).hom ▷ 𝟙 (G.obj y) ≫
          (α_ (α.app y) (G.map (𝟙 y)) (𝟙 (G.obj y))).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map (𝟙 y) ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y))).inv) ≫
      evalMap u α ◁ (G.mapId y).hom ≫ (ρ_ (evalMap u α)).hom).toNatTrans.app Z
    = ((α.app y ≫ 𝟙 (G.obj y)).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u (𝟙 y)).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫
            (α.naturality (𝟙 y)).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj Z) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _)) ≫
      (G.mapId y).hom.toNatTrans.app ((evalMap u α).toFunctor.obj Z) ≫ (𝟙 _)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_right_unitor
statement:
lemma eval_right_unitor (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    evalMap₂ (ρ_ u).hom (ρ_ α).hom
      = (evalMapComp u α (𝟙 y) (𝟙 G)).hom ≫
        evalMap u α ◁ (G.mapId y).hom ≫ (ρ_ (evalMap u α)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalMap₂_rightUnitor, evalMapComp_id_right_hom, F.map₂_right_unitor]
  apply Cat.Hom₂.ext_app; intro Z
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (eval_right_unitor_rhs_app u α Z).symm
  simp [← Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_id_app]

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_hom_app
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_hom_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    (evalMapComp u α v β).hom.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (α.app z ≫ β.app z).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫ (β.app z).toFunctor.map
            ((α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evalMapComp_inv_app
statement:
lemma evalMapComp_inv_app (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    (evalMapComp u α v β).inv.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫ (β.app z).toFunctor.map
            ((α.naturality v).inv.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        (α.app z ≫ β.app z).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).inv.toNatTrans.app Z)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ((α_ (F.map u) (α.app y) (G.map v ≫ β.app z)).hom ≫
        F.map u ◁ ((α_ (α.app y) (G.map v) (β.app z)).inv ≫
          (α.naturality v).inv ▷ β.app z ≫
          (α_ (F.map v) (α.app z) (β.app z)).hom) ≫
        (α_ (F.map u) (F.map v) (α.app z ≫ β.app z)).inv ≫
        (F.mapComp u v).inv ▷ (α.app z ≫ β.app z)).toNatTrans.app Z
      = (𝟙 _) ≫
        ((𝟙 _) ≫ (β.app z).toFunctor.map
            ((α.naturality v).inv.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        (α.app z ≫ β.app z).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).inv.toNatTrans.app Z) := rfl
  exact (congrArg (fun m ↦ m.toNatTrans.app Z) (evalMapComp_inv u α v β)).trans hb

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_whisker_left
statement:
lemma eval_whisker_left (u : x ⟶ y) (α : F ⟶ G) {v v' : y ⟶ z} {β β' : G ⟶ H}
    (σ : v ⟶ v') (Γ : β ⟶ β') :
    evalMap₂ (u ◁ σ) (α ◁ Γ)
      = (evalMapComp u α v β).hom ≫ evalMap u α ◁ evalMap₂ σ Γ ≫
        (evalMapComp u α v' β').inv
proof:
:= by
  apply Cat.Hom₂.ext_app; intro Z
  simp [evalMapComp_hom_app, evalMapComp_inv_app]
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_naturality_conj_app]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_whisker_right
statement:
lemma eval_whisker_right {u u' : x ⟶ y} {α α' : F ⟶ G} (σ : u ⟶ u') (Γ : α ⟶ α')
    (v : y ⟶ z) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    evalMap₂ (σ ▷ v) (Γ ▷ β)
      = (evalMapComp u α v β).hom ≫ evalMap₂ σ Γ ▷ evalMap v β ≫
        (evalMapComp u' α' v β).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply Cat.Hom₂.ext_app; intro Z
  simp [evalMapComp_hom_app, evalMapComp_inv_app,
    Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_naturality_conj_app, modification_naturality_conj,
    Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_hom_app]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1
  simp
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (G.map v).toFunctor
    ((α.naturality u').inv.toNatTrans.app Z) ((α.naturality u').hom.toNatTrans.app Z) (by simp)]
  
  have h1 := (α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.naturality ((F.map₂ σ).toNatTrans.app Z)
  dsimp at h1
  rw [reassoc_of% h1]
  
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_naturality_conj_app]
  
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (G.map v).toFunctor
    ((α.naturality u').inv.toNatTrans.app Z) ((α.naturality u').hom.toNatTrans.app Z) (by simp)]
  
  have h2 := (G.mapComp u' v).inv.toNatTrans.naturality ((Γ.as.app x).toNatTrans.app Z)
  dsimp at h2
  rw [← reassoc_of% h2]
  
  iterate 5 refine congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _) ?_
  exact (congrArg (CategoryStruct.comp _)
    (Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app α' u' v Z)).trans
      (Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc _ _ _)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_associator_rhs_app
statement:
lemma eval_associator_rhs_app (s : x ⟶ y) (δ : F ⟶ G) (u : y ⟶ z) (α : G ⟶ H)
    (v : z ⟶ t) (β : H ⟶ E) (Z : ↑(F.obj x)) :
    ((evalMapComp (s ≫ u) (δ ≫ α) v β).hom ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ u α).hom ▷ evalMap v β ≫
        (α_ (evalMap s δ) (evalMap u α) (evalMap v β)).hom ≫
        evalMap s δ ◁ (evalMapComp u α v β).inv ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ (u ≫ v) (α ≫ β)).inv).toNatTrans.app Z
      = (evalMapComp (s ≫ u) (δ ≫ α) v β).hom.toNatTrans.app Z ≫
        (β.app t).toFunctor.map ((H.map v).toFunctor.map
          ((evalMapComp s δ u α).hom.toNatTrans.app Z)) ≫
        (𝟙 _) ≫
        (evalMapComp u α v β).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((δ.app y).toFunctor.obj ((F.map s).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ (u ≫ v) (α ≫ β)).inv.toNatTrans.app Z

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.eval_associator
statement:
lemma eval_associator (s : x ⟶ y) (δ : F ⟶ G) (u : y ⟶ z) (α : G ⟶ H)
    (v : z ⟶ t) (β : H ⟶ E) :
    evalMap₂ (α_ s u v).hom (α_ δ α β).hom
      = (evalMapComp (s ≫ u) (δ ≫ α) v β).hom ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ u α).hom ▷ evalMap v β ≫
        (α_ (evalMap s δ) (evalMap u α) (evalMap v β)).hom ≫
        evalMap s δ ◁ (evalMapComp u α v β).inv ≫
        (evalMapComp s δ (u ≫ v) (α ≫ β)).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply Cat.Hom₂.ext_app; intro Z
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (eval_associator_rhs_app s δ u α v β Z).symm
  simp only [evalMapComp_hom_app, evalMapComp_inv_app, strongTrans_comp_naturality_app]
  simp
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1
  simp
  rw [map_map_comp_assoc (α.app z).toFunctor (H.map v).toFunctor,
    strongTrans_naturality_slide_assoc]
  
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1
  simp
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app_assoc,
    Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc]
  rw [map_comp_cancel_assoc (G.map v).toFunctor
    ((δ.naturality u).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map s).toFunctor.obj Z))
    ((δ.naturality u).inv.toNatTrans.app ((F.map s).toFunctor.obj Z)) (by simp)]
  rw [strongTrans_naturality_slide_assoc]

      = (f.2.app y.1).toFunctor.map ((x.2.map₂ η.1).toNatTrans.app Z) ≫

statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_mapId_hom_app (x : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) (Z : ↑(x.2.obj x.1)) :

      = (x.2.mapId x.1).hom.toNatTrans.app Z

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_mapComp_hom_app
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_mapComp_hom_app {a b c : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (Z : ↑(a.2.obj a.1)) :
    ((evaluationPseudo (C := C)).mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (f.2.app c.1 ≫ g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((a.2.mapComp f.1 g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app Z) ≫
        (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality g.1).hom.toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj Z))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [evaluationPseudo, evalMapComp]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, whiskerLeftIso_hom, whiskerRightIso_hom,
    Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, NatTrans.comp_app, Cat.whiskerLeft_toNatTrans,
    Cat.whiskerRight_toNatTrans, whiskerLeft_app, whiskerRight_app,
    Cat.associator_hom_toNatTrans_app, Cat.associator_inv_toNatTrans_app,
    Cat.Hom.comp_toFunctor, Functor.comp_obj, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  
  
  simp
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.evaluationPseudo_mapComp_inv_app
statement:
lemma evaluationPseudo_mapComp_inv_app {a b c : C × (C ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (Z : ↑(a.2.obj a.1)) :
    ((evaluationPseudo (C := C)).mapComp f g).inv.toNatTrans.app Z
      = (g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((f.2.naturality g.1).inv.toNatTrans.app ((a.2.map f.1).toFunctor.obj Z)) ≫
        (f.2.app c.1 ≫ g.2.app c.1).toFunctor.map
            ((a.2.mapComp f.1 g.1).inv.toNatTrans.app Z)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [evaluationPseudo, evalMapComp]
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, whiskerLeftIso_inv, whiskerRightIso_inv,
    Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, NatTrans.comp_app, Cat.whiskerLeft_toNatTrans,
    Cat.whiskerRight_toNatTrans, whiskerLeft_app, whiskerRight_app,
    Cat.associator_hom_toNatTrans_app, Cat.associator_inv_toNatTrans_app,
    Cat.Hom.comp_toFunctor, Functor.comp_obj, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  simp
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.map_comp_cancel
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma map_comp_cancel {D E : Type*} [Category D] [Category E] (P : D ⥤ E) {a b : D}
    (A : a ⟶ b) (B : b ⟶ a) (h : A ≫ B = 𝟙 a) :
    P.map A ≫ P.map B = 𝟙 (P.obj a)

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_comp_naturality_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_comp_naturality_app (δ : F ⟶ G) (α : G ⟶ H) {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (W : ↑(F.obj a)) :
    ((δ ≫ α).naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W
      = (α.app b).toFunctor.map ((δ.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W) ≫
        (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app ((δ.app a).toFunctor.obj W)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((δ ≫ α).naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W
      = (𝟙 _) ≫ (α.app b).toFunctor.map ((δ.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W) ≫ (𝟙 _) ≫
        (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app ((δ.app a).toFunctor.obj W) ≫ (𝟙 _) := rfl
  simpa using h

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.map_map_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma map_map_comp {D E W : Type*} [Category D] [Category E] [Category W]
    (Q : D ⥤ E) (P : E ⥤ W) {a b c : D} (A : a ⟶ b) (B : b ⟶ c) :
    P.map (Q.map A) ≫ P.map (Q.map B) = P.map (Q.map (A ≫ B))

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_naturality_slide
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma strongTrans_naturality_slide (α : G ⟶ H) {a b : C} (v : a ⟶ b) {W W' : ↑(G.obj a)}
    (m : W ⟶ W') :
    (α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.app W ≫
        (H.map v).toFunctor.map ((α.app a).toFunctor.map m) ≫
        (α.naturality v).inv.toNatTrans.app W'
      = (α.app b).toFunctor.map ((G.map v).toFunctor.map m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.naturality m
  dsimp at h
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← h, Category.assoc]
  simp

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.strongTrans_comp_naturality_inv_app
statement:
lemma strongTrans_comp_naturality_inv_app (δ : F ⟶ G) (α : G ⟶ H) {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (W : ↑(F.obj a)) :
    ((δ ≫ α).naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app W
      = (α.naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app ((δ.app a).toFunctor.obj W) ≫
        (α.app b).toFunctor.map ((δ.naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app W)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (Cat.Hom.toNatIso ((δ ≫ α).naturality f)).app W
      = (α.app b).toFunctor.mapIso ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (δ.naturality f)).app W) ≪≫
        (Cat.Hom.toNatIso (α.naturality f)).app ((δ.app a).toFunctor.obj W) :=
    Iso.ext (strongTrans_comp_naturality_app δ α f W)
  exact congrArg Iso.inv key

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.naturality_comp_assoc_core
statement:
lemma naturality_comp_assoc_core (α : F ⟶ G) {p q r s : C} (u : p ⟶ q) (v : q ⟶ r) (W : r ⟶ s)
    (x : ↑(F.obj p)) :
    ((G.map W).toFunctor.map ((α.naturality (u ≫ v)).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
        (G.mapComp (u ≫ v) W).inv.toNatTrans.app ((α.app p).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
          (α.naturality ((u ≫ v) ≫ W)).inv.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
      (α.app s).toFunctor.map ((F.map₂ (α_ u v W).hom).toNatTrans.app x) =
    (G.map W).toFunctor.map
        ((α.app r).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          (α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
      (G.mapComp v W).inv.toNatTrans.app
          ((α.app q).toFunctor.obj ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj x)) ≫
        (G.map (v ≫ W)).toFunctor.map ((α.naturality u).hom.toNatTrans.app x) ≫
          (G.mapComp u (v ≫ W)).inv.toNatTrans.app ((α.app p).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
            (α.naturality (u ≫ v ≫ W)).inv.toNatTrans.app x
proof:
:= by
  simp
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app_assoc α (u ≫ v) W x,
    Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc,
    map_comp_cancel_assoc (G.map W).toFunctor
      ((α.naturality (u ≫ v)).hom.toNatTrans.app x)
      ((α.naturality (u ≫ v)).inv.toNatTrans.app x)
      (Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (α.naturality (u ≫ v)) _),
    map_comp_cancel_assoc (α.app s).toFunctor
      ((F.mapComp (u ≫ v) W).inv.toNatTrans.app x)
      ((F.mapComp (u ≫ v) W).hom.toNatTrans.app x)
      (Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app (F.mapComp (u ≫ v) W) _)]
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app α u (v ≫ W) x,
    Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc,
    map_comp_cancel_assoc (G.map (v ≫ W)).toFunctor
      ((α.naturality u).hom.toNatTrans.app x)
      ((α.naturality u).inv.toNatTrans.app x)
      (Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (α.naturality u) _)]
  rw [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.naturality_comp_inv_app_assoc α v W ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj x),
    Cat.Hom.inv_hom_id_toNatTrans_app_assoc,
    map_comp_cancel_assoc (G.map W).toFunctor
      ((α.naturality v).hom.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj x))
      ((α.naturality v).inv.toNatTrans.app ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj x))
      (Cat.Hom.hom_inv_id_toNatTrans_app (α.naturality v) _)]
  have hfin : (G.map W).toFunctor.map
        ((α.app r).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).hom.toNatTrans.app x)) ≫
      (α.naturality W).inv.toNatTrans.app
        ((F.map v).toFunctor.obj ((F.map u).toFunctor.obj x))
      = (α.naturality W).inv.toNatTrans.app ((F.map (u ≫ v)).toFunctor.obj x) ≫
        (α.app s).toFunctor.map
          ((F.map W).toFunctor.map ((F.mapComp u v).hom.toNatTrans.app x)) :=
    (α.naturality W).inv.toNatTrans.naturality _
  rw [reassoc_of% hfin]

name: CategoryTheory.Bicategory.modification_naturality_conj
statement:
lemma modification_naturality_conj {α α' : F ⟶ G} (Γ : α ⟶ α') {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b)
    (W : ↑(F.obj a)) :
    (Γ.as.app b).toNatTrans.app ((F.map f).toFunctor.obj W)
      = (α.naturality f).hom.toNatTrans.app W ≫
        (G.map f).toFunctor.map ((Γ.as.app a).toNatTrans.app W) ≫
        (α'.naturality f).inv.toNatTrans.app W
proof:
:= by
  have h := modification_naturality_app Γ f W
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  exact (Iso.eq_comp_inv ((Cat.Hom.toNatIso (α'.naturality f)).app W)).mpr h

lemma yonedaPairing_mapId_app (a : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})) (Z : ↑(yonedaPairing.obj a))
    (γ : Bᵒᵖ) (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop a.1)).obj γ)) :
    (((yonedaPairing.mapId a).hom.toNatTrans.app Z).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ
      = (Z.app γ).toFunctor.map (ρ_ ZZ).hom
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [yonedaPairing, yonedaPairingComposite, Pseudofunctor.comp, homPseudo,
    homMapId, homMapIdApp, Pseudofunctor.prod, Pseudofunctor.op]
  simp only [prelax_map₂_app, Iso.trans_hom, Cat.Hom.isoMk_hom, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app,
    Cat.toCatHom₂_toNatTrans, Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, NatTrans.comp_app,
    PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, Category.assoc]
  
  change (Z.app γ).toFunctor.map (ρ_ ZZ).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
  simp

name: Biyoneda.yonedaPairing_mapComp_app
statement:
lemma yonedaPairing_mapComp_app {a b c : Bᵒᵖ × (Bᵒᵖ ⥤ᵖ Cat.{w, v})} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c)
    (Z : ↑(yonedaPairing.obj a)) (γ : Bᵒᵖ) (ZZ : ↑((yoneda₀ (unop c.1)).obj γ)) :
    (((yonedaPairing.mapComp f g).hom.toNatTrans.app Z).as.app γ).toNatTrans.app ZZ
      = (g.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
          ((f.2.app γ).toFunctor.map
            ((Z.app γ).toFunctor.map (α_ ZZ g.1.unop f.1.unop).inv))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [yonedaPairing, yonedaPairingComposite, Pseudofunctor.comp, homPseudo,
    homMapComp, homMapCompApp, Pseudofunctor.prod, Pseudofunctor.op]
  simp only [prelax_map₂_app, Iso.trans_hom, Cat.Hom.isoMk_hom, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app,
    Cat.toCatHom₂_toNatTrans, Cat.Hom.toNatTrans_comp, NatTrans.comp_app,
    PrelaxFunctor.map₂Iso_hom, Category.assoc]
  
  change _ ≫ _ ≫ _ ≫ _ ≫ _ ≫ _ = _
  dsimp only [Pseudofunctor.StrongTrans.comp_app]
  simp only [whiskerLeftIso_hom, whiskerRightIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    whiskerLeft_as_app, whiskerRight_as_app, associator_hom_as_app, associator_inv_as_app]
  simp only [Cat.whiskerRight_app, Cat.whiskerLeft_app, Cat.associator_hom_app,
    Cat.associator_inv_app, Cat.Hom.comp_toFunctor, Functor.comp_obj]
  simp
  
  
  exact Category.comp_id _
